system.description: This rune must be inscribed on a blunt weapon. A victim actually struck by the Thuul with this weapon suffers Anvil Shock according to the inscribed rune level. The rune remains active permanently but requires its associated Divinity Points. Levels 1, 2 and 3 impose penalties of -2, -4 and -6 to all actions for the remainder of the current action round and the whole next round. Level 4 prevents all actions for that same duration; level 5 prevents all actions for the current round and the next two rounds.
system.summary: Gives a blunt weapon an earth-shaking impact that weakens or immobilizes its victim.
